title: Lockdown
text: Radio: the district collector orders a total lockdown. Stay indoors. Police are setting up checkpoints on the highway.

title: Panic buying
text: Panic buying empties the kirana stores: queues, shouting, shutters slammed down by noon.

title: Gunshots at the bus stand
text: Gunshots at the bus stand: police firing into a crowd of the sick. The noise carries across town.

title: Pharmacy raided
text: A gang breaks into New Life Pharmacy at night. Shots are fired; half the shelves are cleared.

title: Relief camp
text: Radio: a relief camp opens at the Government Higher Secondary School, with rice, water and medical aid. Soldiers guard the gate.

title: Camp overrun
text: Screams from the relief camp before dawn: an evacuee who hid a bite turned in the crowded hall. The camp is overrun; its supplies are left behind among the infected.

title: Checkpoint abandoned
text: The police checkpoint on the highway is empty. The officers left in a hurry; the station's armoury door hangs open.

title: The radio goes silent
text: The district radio stops mid-sentence and does not come back. Nobody is coming.

title: A stranger at the gate
text: Someone calls from the street: {name}, {age}, a {profession}, alone and out of water, asking to join you.

decision.text: {name} ({profession}, {age}) asks to join the group and says they are not hurt. Let them in?

title: Market fire
text: A cooking fire left burning in a looted shop catches in the dry afternoon heat. The market burns for hours.

title: Heat wave
text: A heat wave settles over the plains: 3 °C hotter for the next four days. Water need climbs; weakened infected start to die in the streets.

title: Pre-monsoon storm
text: A pre-monsoon thunderstorm: 25 mm of rain in an hour. Roof tanks and every open container fill.
